Smooth Square End Wheel and Carrier Assembly, Acorn BC1BI

Acorn's Barn Door Hardware Miscellaneous Parts, Wheel Carrier. This square end wheel carrier is perfect to use on any barn door. The carrier is completed in a smooth iron style with a matte black powder coat finish, is durable and wear-resistant.

Features and Specifications of the Wheel and Carrier Assembly:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Lifetime no rust warranty.
